commands.title: Muse Bridge: Check for tasks now

museBridge.autoStart.description: Start polling automatically when VS Code starts (if repoPath is set).

museBridge.clineCommand.description: Command used to invoke the Cline CLI for the fallback path (full path if not on PATH).

museBridge.defaultTimeoutSec.description: Kill a running task after this many seconds (unless the task sets timeout_sec).

museBridge.heartbeatSec.description: How often to push a heartbeat status to the bridge repo while a task runs.

museBridge.pollIntervalSec.description: How often to pull the bridge repo and look for pending tasks.

museBridge.preferClineApi.description: Try driving the Cline VS Code extension via its API first; fall back to the Cline CLI when the API surface is unavailable.

museBridge.repoPath.description: Local clone of the private bridge GitHub repo (e.g. C:\Users\Darek\muse-cline-bridge). Leave empty to keep the bridge disabled.

description: Polls a GitHub bridge repo for architect tasks from Muse and runs them through Cline, reporting results back.
name: muse-cline-bridge
